items.headline: Mizuho Upgrades Albemarle to Outperform from Neutral
items.snippet: Fintel reports that on October 14, 2026, Mizuho upgraded Albemarle (NYSE:ALB) from Neutral to Outperform. Barclays initiated at Equal-Weight Oct 13; Argus Buy Oct 7; UBS Buy Oct 5.

items.headline: Albemarle upgraded to Outperform from Neutral at Mizuho
items.snippet: Mizuho upgraded Albemarle to Outperform from Neutral with an unchanged $130 price target. Strong BESS demand has tipped the market balance favorable; raises 2027 Energy Storage price forecast to $21k from $17k.

items.headline: Bear of the Day: Albemarle Corporation (ALB)
items.snippet: Zacks Rank #5 (Strong Sell): Q3 and Q4 earnings estimates cut 13% and 36% since Q2 results; EV growth has cooled and lithium prices remain far below late-2022 highs.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered its price target on Albemarle to $135 from $230 and keeps a Buy rating; lithium up about 67% y/y but below highs; supply/demand poised to improve into 2027.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $175 from $200 at BMO Capital
items.snippet: BMO lowered its price target on Albemarle to $175 from $200 and keeps Outperform, citing recent lithium spot price weakness; group still viewed as oversold.
